title: eiwz-extreme
label: Pain

won.source: The fed's own served Christmas Bash 1998 results: Pain wins a ten-man Royal Rumble main event billed "THE NEW EIWZ EXTREME CHAMPION." No exact day survives; the PPV's own name places it in December 1998.

end.source: No further title change is recorded in the held corpus; the fed's own December 17, 1998 results page records Pain retaining the belt against Jazz, the held record's last-attested result for this title.

how: Won a ten-man Royal Rumble main event; the belt's own earliest documented reign in the held record.
note: Retained against Jazz on December 17, 1998, per the fed's own served results page — not a new reign.
